# FDD rules

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/nf/gen_rule_docs.py from nf-app/static/fdd-catalog.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Open-FDD ships **77 SQL rules**. The FDD hook runs every runnable rule hourly on every piece of equipment whose
Haystack model fills the rule's roles (see [Modeling](modeling.html)). All thresholds are **SI** (see
[Units](units.html)); the defaults below are the pack's, and each can be tuned per site in the app.

- **Roles** are the inputs a rule needs, named after NF point classes / Haystack markers. A rule runs only when
  every *required* role is bound; *optional* roles refine the result.
- **Equipment kinds** are the Haystack equipment kinds a rule applies to (empty = any equipment).
- `confirm` is how long a condition must hold before it counts as a fault.
- Each rule id links to its entry in the [Rule Cookbook](rules/): the SQL at defaults, the full parameter limits,
  the pandas twin and the parity status. This page is only the one-table catalog.
- Rule SQL lives in `sql/fdd/postgres/rules/`; the SQLite pack is generated from it
  (see [Development](development.html)).

Regenerate this page with `python3 scripts/nf/gen_rule_docs.py` (`--check` fails when it is stale).
